abstractEnglish: We construct a Smith–Toda complex $`V(4)`$ at the prime 1009. It is an ordinary finite 1009-local spectrum whose Brown–Peterson homology is $`BP_*/(1009,v_1,v_2,v_3,v_4)`$, with its canonical comodule structure and generator in degree zero.
